nodes.name: Lemma 1
Claim 1
nodes.statement:
\textit{
		If \[{\mathbf{A^*}} \in \mathbb{R}^{n \times m}\] is \[\mu\]-incoherent and \[\|{\mathbf{A}}^*_i - {\mathbf{A}}^{(t)}_i\| \leq \epsilon_t \]  holds for each \[i \in [1\dots m]\], then \[{\mathbf{A}}^{(t)}\in \mathbb{R}^{n \times m}\] is \[\mu_t\]-incoherent, where \[\mu_t = \mu + 2\sqrt{n}\epsilon_t\].}

Lemma 3
nodes.statement:
With probability at least \[(1 - \delta_{\beta}^{(t)} - \delta_{{{\mathcal{T}}}}^{(t)})\] the error incurred by each element \[i_1 \in {\rm supp}({\mathbf{x}}^*)\] of the coefficient estimate is upper-bounded as
 	\begin{align*}
 	
 	
 	|\widehat{{\mathbf{x}}}_{i_1} - {\mathbf{x}}_{i_1}^*|
 
 	&\leq    \mathcal{O}(t_\beta) + \left({(R + 1)}k \eta_x\tfrac{\mu_t}{\sqrt{n}}~\underset{i}{\max}|{\mathbf{x}}_{i}^{(0)} - {\mathbf{x}}_{i}^*| + |{\mathbf{x}}_{i_1}^{(0)} - {\mathbf{x}}_{i_1}^*| \right)\delta_{R},
 	
 	=  \mathcal{O}(t_\beta)
 	\end{align*}
 	
 	where \[t_\beta = \mathcal{O}(\sqrt{k\epsilon_t})\], \[\delta_{R} := (1 - \eta_{x} + \eta_x\tfrac{\mu_t}{\sqrt{n}})^{R}\], \[\delta_{{{\mathcal{T}}}}^{(t)} = 2m~{\exp}({-\tfrac{C^2}{\mathcal{O}^*(\epsilon_t^2)}})\], \[\delta_{\beta}^{(t)} = 2k~{\exp}(-\tfrac{1}{\mathcal{O}(\epsilon_t)})\], and \[\mu_t\] is the incoherence between the columns of \[{\mathbf{A}}^{(t)}\]; see Claim~1.

nodes.statement:
With probability at least \[(1 - \delta_{\beta}^{(t)} - \delta_{{{\mathcal{T}}}}^{(t)} - \delta_{\rm HW}^{(t)} - \delta_{{\mathbf{g}}}^{(t)})\], 
	\[\|\widehat{{\mathbf{g}}}^{(t)} -  {\mathbf{g}}^{(t)}\|\] is upper-bounded by \[ \mathcal{O}^*(\tfrac{k}{ m} \|{\mathbf{A}}^*\| )\], 
		where \[\delta_{{\mathbf{g}}}^{(t)} = (n+m)\exp(-\Omega(m\sqrt{\log(n)})\].

nodes.name: Claim 10
Lemma 9
nodes.statement:
Suppose \[{\mathbf{A}}^{(t)}\] is \[(\epsilon_t, 2)\] near to \[{\mathbf{A}}^*\] with \[\epsilon_t = \mathcal{O}^*(1/\log(n))\], and number of samples used in step \[t\] is \[p = \widetilde{\Omega}(mk^2)\], then with probability at least \[(1 - \delta_{{{\mathcal{T}}}}^{(t)} - \delta_{\beta}^{(t)} 
	- \delta_{\rm HW}^{(t)}- \delta_{{\mathbf{g}}}^{(t)})\], \[{\mathbf{A}}^{(t+1)}\] satisfies \[\|{\mathbf{A}}^{(t+1)} - {\mathbf{A}}^*\| \leq 2\|{\mathbf{A}}^*\|\].
